user.title: Stewart CVM
user.description: List the preset aspect ratios and motor positions in the CVM's preset order (1, 2, 3, …), separated by commas. The motor positions can be recalibrated later from Configure.

import_legacy.title: Import {title}
import_legacy.description: Takes over the old CVM integration's setup for {host}: its settings, device and entities, so entity IDs, history, areas and automations keep working. The old entry is removed afterwards.

error.invalid_auth: The controller didn't accept the username and password
error.invalid_presets: Aspect ratios and motor positions must be comma-separated numbers, one position per aspect ratio, with no repeated aspect ratio

abort.no_legacy_entry: No setup from the old CVM integration was found.

init.description: With Recalibrate on, each preset is recalled in turn and its motor position recorded, which moves the mask. Turn it off to save the motor positions as entered.
